part.text: The bug is in the non-recursive walk in `pageMapQueryPagesInSection` (hugolib/content_map_page.go:486): it only remembers the *last* branch seen. The radix tree walk is lexicographic, so with `s1` and `s1-foo`, descendants of `s1` (e.g. `/s1/p1`) are visited *after* `/s1-foo/...`, and the single `otherBranch = "/s1-foo/"` no longer matches, so leaf pages leak into the parent's `.Pages`. Fix: track all branch prefixes.

part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in the non-recursive `.Pages` walk in `hugolib/content_map_page.go` (used for home/section `.Pages` and `.PagesInSection` queries): the radix-tree walk visits keys in lexicographic order, and with similarly-named adjacent sections (`s1` vs `s1-foo`), the descendants of `s1` (`/s1/p1`) are visited *after* `/s1-foo/...`. The old code only remembered the single most recent branch prefix (`otherBranch = "/s1-foo/"`), so it failed to skip `s1`'s leaf pages, leaking them into the parent's `.Pages`.

The fix tracks all branch prefixes seen so far (checking `strings.HasPrefix` against each), pruning branches that can never match again since the walk is sorted. Verified with a reproduction of the issue's test case (passes: `__|s1|s1-foo|__`) and the full `./hugolib/...`, `./resources/...`, `./tpl/...`, and `./common/...` test suites — no regressions.
